envelope.description: Revise guard foundations and remove numeric-PID signalling authority

body.title: Revise guard foundations and remove numeric-PID signalling authority
body.summary: Reuse the existing atomic mkdir/nonce guard, file fingerprints and orphan diagnostics under the cooperating-managed-writer contract. Revise source/docs/tests that imply atomic conditional unlink. Keep OS identity observation diagnostic; remove or explicitly refuse the failed check-then-act signalling helper so no production target can be signalled through it. Reconcile the failed t1 work rather than claiming it completed. Revalidation is mandatory; previous t1 test results do not constitute a completed task.
acceptanceChecks: Existing guard tests prove exclusive managed-writer acquisition and preservation of observed foreign files.
Orphan/unverifiable guards remain explicit conflicts without automatic reclamation.
No identity-check-then-numeric-kill API remains usable as production daemon signalling authority.

tests.name: Managed run-file guard exclusion, observed replacement preservation and explicit orphan conflict
Observation-only process identities cannot authorize numeric-PID target signalling
Revised guard foundation regressions pass without claiming atomic conditional unlink
